checks.text: The page shows the heading "Dream Journal" and, with no entries, the text "No dreams yet".

In the form, typing "Flying" in the field labelled "Title", "I soared over a lake" in the field labelled "Description", and "night, calm" in the field labelled "Tags", then clicking the button "Save dream" adds a list item containing "Flying", "I soared over a lake", and the tags "night" and "calm"; the text "No dreams yet" is gone.

After adding the dream from A2, clicking the button "Edit Flying" opens the form with the field labelled "Title" showing "Flying" and the field labelled "Description" showing "I soared over a lake"; changing the field labelled "Description" to "I soared over a river" and clicking "Save dream" updates the list item to contain "I soared over a river".

With the dream from A2 present, typing "soared" in the field labelled "Search" filters the list to show only the item containing "Flying"; typing "zzz" in the field labelled "Search" shows the text "No dreams match".

With the dream from A2 present, selecting "night" in the select labelled "Tag" filters the list to show the item containing "Flying"; selecting "calm" in the select labelled "Tag" also shows the item containing "Flying"; selecting "work" in the select labelled "Tag" shows the text "No dreams match".
With the dream from A2 present, clicking the button "Delete Flying" removes that list item and the page shows the text "No dreams yet".
With the dream from A2 present, clicking the button "Export CSV" shows the toast "Exported 1 dream(s) to CSV".
After adding the dream from A2, reloading the page still shows the list item containing "Flying" and "I soared over a lake".
Reload keeps the dream titled "Flying" with the description "I soared over a lake" and the tags "night" and "calm".
